headline.text: Trailing twelve months: revenue ₹1,38,052 cr, EBITDA ₹28,433 cr (20.6% margin), PAT ₹18,330 cr.

claims.text: Revenue compounded at 11.5% a year over FY21–FY26 (₹75,379 cr → ₹1,30,144 cr).
FY26 revenue growth of 11.2% was within its 5-year range (6.5% to 18.5%).
EBITDA margin compressed by 175 bps over FY23–FY26 (22.3% → 20.6%).
PAT compounded at 8.3% a year over FY21–FY26, lagging revenue.
Debt-to-equity was 0.08 at FY27 end (0.08 at FY24).
Over the last 5 years, operating cash flow was 1.27× reported profit (₹99,593 cr vs ₹78,129 cr) — profits are turning into cash.

citations.excerpt: Net cash flows from operating activities (A) 19,975 22,261

claims.text: Free cash flow (as computed by screener.in) was positive in 5 of the last 5 years, ₹93,096 cr in total.
Capex over the last 5 years was ₹6,497 cr, 7% of operating cash flow (derived as operating cash flow − free cash flow).
Cash conversion cycle held steady from 92 to 88 days over FY23–FY26.
Return on capital employed was 30% in FY26 (28% in FY23).

statements.quote: So the gross margins will be upwards of 70%.

statements.quote: But you're already at 4% YoY growth in your Services business in CC terms, and you have a strong pipeline, and you’re saying the outlook also is good.

statements.quote: I think our earlier aspiration was 18% to 19%, and this year, we specifically called out the restructuring charges, and then we had reduced the guidance to 17.5% to 18.5%.

statements.speaker: C. Vijayakumar
statements.quote: Global datacenter demand is set to triple by 2030 with AI driving roughly 70% of that growth, and in India that growth is expected to happen at an even faster pace.

statements.speaker: C. Vijayakumar
statements.quote: Looking ahead, we are retaining our guidance of 1% to 4% and margin guidance of 17.5% to 18.5% for FY27.

statements.quote: And this year the guidance is 17.5% to 18.5% and that also includes approximately 40 to 50 basis points restructuring cost impact.

statements.speaker: C. Vijayakumar
statements.quote: Yes, of course, from last year to this year our guidance is improving gross margins, but I think if our strategy works out as we have planned, we do expect the gross margin per employee to increase.

statements.quote: And Gaurav, on the margin’s guidelines, as we called out, our revenue as well as margin guidance are for the organic business.

statements.quote: And the third one if I may squeeze in, if you add back that 50 basis points of impact because of these two accounts, still it would be like you are essentially talking about 2% to 5% kind of growth in services, which might be a bit tad softer than what we are anticipating.

statements.quote: On the back of a standout quarter and sustained growth momentum, we are raising our full year services revenue growth guidance to 4.75% to 5.25% in constant currency terms and the company level guidance to 4% to 4.5% in constant currency terms.

overview.excerpt: Our Business We are a global technology company, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around AI, digital, engineering, cloud and software, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. Our ambition is to be the best AI solutions company in the world.

We became the first large-cap, India- headquartered technology services company to report Advanced AI revenue—a category spanning AI Factory, Physical AI, Robotics, AI Engineering and Custom Silicon, and distinct from Classical AI and usage of AI in traditional services—and reaching annualized Advanced AI revenue of $620 million.

“We became the first large-cap, India-headquartered technology services company to report Advanced AI revenue. For the third straight year, HCLTech outperformed its comparable peers in FY26, with the fastest constant currency overall revenue growth.

management.excerpt: Number three, margins expanded significantly through disciplined execution and higher-margin Advanced AI revenue. Before I go through the numbers, please note that all growth rates that I mention are in constant currency, except for bookings and ARR. Our services business, which is more than 90% of our business, delivered a strong performance.
management.speaker: C Vijayakumar

management.excerpt: Growth was broad-based across verticals and geographies, reflecting how closely our portfolio is aligned with the clients -- with what the clients are prioritizing today, be it AI, cloud, data, cybersecurity, or application modernization. Advanced AI revenue reached $219 million this quarter, up 28.4% sequentially and 78% YoY. And the annualized Advanced AI revenue is now $876 million.
management.speaker: C Vijayakumar
